**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- The fix is one comparison in `plan_trochoidal_slot` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/trochoid_slot.rs:202`). A band `b` above the tool radius opens the bore. A band at or under it keeps the plain bore. This matches the decision file.
- The helix-turn refusal still holds. It lives in `trochoid_bore::bore` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/trochoid_bore.rs:79-92`), before any move is emitted. The opened bore takes the same path: `helix_turns` returns None, and the plan errors by name. The narrow case keeps the old message. The opened case says "half the tool radius - use a smaller stepdown". No bypass.
- The golden `trochoid_slot_small.cl` is unchanged. The fixture uses D 6 and W 10: band 2, radius 3, so `b <= r` takes the plain branch byte for byte. The diff touches no golden file.
- The pinning test is non-vacuous. The lib test `the_opened_bore_leaves_no_post_at_the_lane_start` asserts the plain bore leaves more than 4 mm2 on the same band shape. That pins the failure the fix must remove. The PR also ran the wide-channel test with the plain bore forced: 19.72 mm2 standing, so the test fails without the change.
- `a_slot_band_within_the_tool_radius_keeps_the_plain_bore` compares the slot path with the plain-bore plan move for move. A wrong threshold would move those paths and fail the test.
- The doc comment in `trochoid_bore.rs` now states the rule for both callers. The provenance line stays intact.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/1589-troch-slot-open-bore.md` follows the format in `docs/decisions/README.md`.
- Tests sit in `camcraft-motion`, and the Gate map lines name the covered modules. All touched files stay under 400 lines. No new dependency. No unwrap or panic in shipped code.

## Results

Ran on the self-hosted runner (macOS): https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43612187086 — head check passed, trial merge with main `b6c02115a` clean, quick gate on the merged tree green.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| motion suites | 737 passed, 0 failed |
| app suites | 473 passed, 0 failed |
| `trochoid_wide_channel_leaves_no_post_at_the_start` | ok |
| `the_opened_bore_leaves_no_post_at_the_lane_start` | ok |
| `a_slot_band_within_the_tool_radius_keeps_the_plain_bore` | ok |
| `trochoid_bore_past_the_helix_turn_cap_is_refused` | ok |
| `trochoid_slot_small_matches_golden` | ok |
| clippy `-p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The diff adds no `cfg(windows)` line and no per-OS pinned value, so the runner's arm covers the change.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `plan_trochoidal_slot` now calls `p.band()?` before `plan_lane` calls `p.validate()?`. For input that is invalid in two ways at once, the first shown refusal can be the band message instead of the validate message. Both are refusals by name, so this is a wording note only.
- The turn-cap interaction with an opened bore has no pinned test: a very deep stepdown on a wide slot. The refusal exists in code and the PR names the case under "What was not exercised". A follow-up test (P7) could pin the "half the tool radius" message. Not a blocker for this PR.

## What was not exercised

- The GUI was not started, and no project round-trip was run.
- The heavy release-lane suites were not run.
- A deep stepdown on a wide slot (the opened-bore turn-cap case) was not tested, by the author and by this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
